summary: Verified WEB iteration 403: app-download banner removed everywhere, Resources articles index widened to max-w-7xl with lg:grid-cols-4, result count reads '44 articles', all 44 card images load (naturalWidth > 0, zero broken). All 7 legacy->canonical slug redirects work and merged slugs no longer appear as cards. All 5 rewritten flagship articles render NEW structure: Your Next Step CTA (data-testid article-next-step), Sources, hero image, NO Key Takeaways, NO FAQ. CTA wording and hrefs are correct (estimator on how-much, free_decode on the other four; secondary trial -> /pricing). Disclosures 'One free statement decode every 120 days...' and 'Card required. After 7 days, Solo is A$24.50...' render as specified. Visuals present: PullQuote ($14) + BarChart on how-much; FigureStats with $140,652.80 and $88,934.57 on lifetime-cap; BarChart on three-streams; SectionFigure on what-happened and support-at-home-explained. Index HCP card title uses correct lowercase 'and'/'the'. Regression: how-to-switch article still renders with sidebar TOC. Minor divergence: on how-much the H2s 'Work From Your Fee Advice' and 'What If I Cannot Afford the Contribution?' render as 'Work from Your Fee Advice' and 'What if I Cannot Afford the Contribution?' because titleCaseHeading downcases 'from'/'if'; that conflicts with the sections listed verbatim in the review request (but is consistent with the general 'small words lowercase' rule). 23 generic 'Failed to load resource: 404' console errors (not blocking; same pattern as previous iterations - likely analytics/pixel endpoints).

issues: H2 section headings render as 'Work from Your Fee Advice' and 'What if I Cannot Afford the Contribution?' (lowercase 'from'/'if') because titleCaseHeading treats them as small words. The review request listed these sections with capital F/I ('Work From...', 'What If...'). Decide whether to (a) extend the small-words whitelist in /app/frontend/src/lib/titleCase.js to exclude 'from' and 'if', or (b) accept this as correct Title Case (it matches the stated rule 'small words like and/the/to/for/a are lowercase mid-title').

action_items: Decide: should 'from' and 'if' be capitalized mid-title in titleCaseHeading? If yes, remove them from the small-words list in /app/frontend/src/lib/titleCase.js so the how-much article's H2s match the spec verbatim.
Audit the 23 generic 404 console errors on article pages (likely analytics beacons / og.png / preload) - cosmetic but adds noise.
critical_code_review_comments: titleCaseHeading downcases 'from' and 'if'. The editorial spec explicitly listed sections with capital F/I - confirm with product whether the function's small-words list should be tightened.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (one Title-Case edge case on 2 section headings)

rca of the issue: N/A - feature additions verified. The only flag is a Title-Case rule interpretation on two section headings; root cause is titleCaseHeading's SMALL_WORDS set including 'from' and 'if'.
